title: AppOmni Event Presence
summary: Trade-show booth design and environmental graphics for AppOmni's conference presence, including confirmed appearances at Cisco Live and Black Hat USA 2026.
overview: Booth design, environmental installations, and event-presence graphics supporting AppOmni's trade-show and conference programming. Two shows are directly confirmed by the materials themselves: Cisco Live (a speaker promo graphic for the May 2026 show) and Black Hat USA 2026 (an attendee-meeting promo for August 5–6, 2026). The booth floorplans, isometric build renders, and the environmental installation shown here are not independently tied to a specific show in the material reviewed -- they're presented as booth-design and environmental-graphics work generally, not attributed to any one event beyond what's confirmed.

Three labeled booth wall elevations -- Reception Panel, Swag Wall, Main Wall, and Demo Station -- each showing AppOmni branding and a staff member for scale
